task: construct financing intensity before outcome analysis
hypothesis: Financing balance relative to company size may proxy leveraged demand; alternatively only follows prices/size/eligibility
formula: median over prior-month industry members of financing_balance(snapshot T-2 trading sessions)/market_cap(signal T)
denominator: raw_close(T)*total_shares(T), positive finite listed stock; share_effective_date<=T; no known_at certification
timing: snapshot delay inherited and checked R44; denominator contemporaneous signal close; no lookahead price
aggregation: equal-company median then later same-date within-era/level ranks; no pooling levels
coverage: >=5 valid company ratios and >=80% of all prior-month members; otherwise missing; full raw median retained only for coverage audit
missing: absent margin record unknown not0; reported0 numerator retained; missing cap unknown; no forward fill
controls: planned F and size on identical industry dates; denominator price exposure explicitly controlled
scope: 2018-12..2026-04 local sources only; no ETF mapping or stock-model conclusion reuse
